verdict.rationale: BigCommerce has a first-party solution page for omnichannel ecommerce, which points to multi-channel selling from its platform. The evidence pack contains only the page title, though: nothing shows listing or syncing catalog products to marketplaces, social commerce, or shopping feeds. The 'BigCommerce marketplace' reference is the app marketplace, and the 1,200 apps are third-party, so neither counts here. Missing for 10: documented marketplace listing/sync, social commerce channel integrations, shopping feed generation, single-catalog sync behavior details, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant, I can list and sync products to external channels — marketplaces, social commerce, shopping feeds — from one catalog
